description: Source code for an IPC service backend implementation using Zephyr's icmsg framework, specifically for the 'ipc_icmsg_me_follower' backend. It manages endpoint registration, message handling, and binding logic.

methods.name: get_ept_cached_loc
methods.description: Retrieves a local endpoint configuration from cache based on name.

methods.name: get_ept_cached_rmt
methods.description: Retrieves a remote endpoint cache entry based on name.

methods.name: cache_ept_rmt
methods.description: Caches a remote endpoint with its name and ID.

methods.name: bind_ept
methods.description: Binds an endpoint ID to a configuration and notifies via icmsg.

methods.name: bound
methods.description: Callback invoked when the backend is bound.

methods.name: received
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, updates cache, and triggers binding if necessary.

methods.name: register_ept
methods.description: Registers an endpoint, manages cache, and binds if ID is known.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message through the icmsg framework using a token.

methods.name: backend_init
methods.description: Initializes the backend device, including mutex and icmsg setup.
